title: Add a tree / tree-grid object view type for self-referencing hierarchies (business unit, org chart)
body:
## Problem

Hierarchical, self-referencing objects (business unit / org chart, category trees, menu trees, BOM, nested comments) have **no native view type** to render them with indentation + expand/collapse. Today they can only be shown flat in a Grid, reading the `parent` field manually — the hierarchy is invisible.

The data layer and a generic UI component already exist; what's missing is the object-view integration that ties them together.

## What already exists (foundation)

- **`tree` field type (self-reference)** — data layer supports `{ type: 'tree', reference: '<self>' }`, i.e. a single-parent pointer. Unambiguous, unlike Airtable's many-to-many links (which is *why* Airtable has no tree view; we don't have that blocker). See `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/field-types.ts:36`.
- **Generic `TreeViewSchema` component** — expand/collapse tree renderer, but it consumes `TreeNode[]` and is **not bound to object record data** (more like a folder browser). `packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/tree-view.tsx`.

## What's missing (the gap)

The 10 object view types (`list / grid / kanban / calendar / timeline / map / gallery / gantt / chart / detail`, see `packages/types/src/views.ts:28`) do **not** include `tree`. The view-type → component dispatch switch at `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:685` has no `case 'tree'`, and there is no `plugin-tree` package.

## Why not just use Grouping (à la Airtable)?

Grouping handles **fixed-depth** hierarchies (dept → team → person). It cannot express an **arbitrary-depth self-referencing** tree (A's parent is B, B's parent is C, …unbounded). That is precisely the business-unit / org-chart case and the reason we need a real tree view, not grouping.

| Scenario | Use |
|---|---|
| Fixed, known levels | Grid + Grouping (no new view needed) |
| Self-referencing, unbounded depth (business unit, menu, BOM, nested comments) | **tree-grid** (this issue) |

## Proposed scope

Start with **tree-grid** (a tree table — columns, with the first column indented/expandable), since it subsumes a plain tree.

1. Add `'tree'` to the `ViewType` union — `packages/types/src/views.ts`.
2. New `plugin-tree` package (mirror `plugin-kanban` / `plugin-gantt` structure). Core work: transform flat records with a self-referencing `parent` field into a nested structure, feed into the existing `TreeViewSchema` / a tree-grid renderer.
3. Register `case 'tree'` in the dispatch switch — `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`.
4. Add tree icon + label to `ViewSwitcher` (plugin-list).

### Open questions
- Config surface: which field is the parent pointer (auto-detect the `tree`/self-`reference` field, or explicit `tree.parentField`?), root filter, default expand depth, lazy-load vs. fetch-all.
- Server-side: fetch the whole subtree at once vs. lazy children fetch per node (perf for large trees).
- Drag-to-reparent — in scope for v1 or a follow-up?

## Acceptance (v1)
- A self-referencing object renders as an indented, expand/collapse tree-grid with columns.
- Parent field auto-detected from the object's `tree` field; configurable override.
- Reads via the generic data API (no bespoke endpoint).
